name: NVIDIA ACE for Games
shortDescription: NVIDIA ACE toolkit for in-game characters, including developer downloads. Not a simple SaaS signup.
longDescription: NVIDIA ACE for Games is a developer toolkit for in-game characters. The page describes downloads and plugins, and Unreal plugins were noted as MIT-licensed. It is not a simple hosted free tier, and it assumes NVIDIA developer access and hardware.
pricingNotes: SDK/download model rather than subscription grid on the page we read.
bestFor: Game teams already on NVIDIA’s developer stack
